module result_value_array_field_ensures

error NotFound

type Address is record
    city_id: Integer
end record

type Customer is record
    id: Integer
    address: Address
end record

function load() returns Result<Array<Customer, 2>, NotFound>
ensures success
ensures value[0].id = 1
ensures value[1].address.city_id = 7
is
    let first: Customer = Customer { id: 1, address: Address { city_id: 42 } }
    let second: Customer = Customer { id: 2, address: Address { city_id: 7 } }
    return ok [first, second]
end load

end result_value_array_field_ensures
